question: Which of the following teams won the 15th edition of the Indian Premier League cricket tournament in the year 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gujarat Titans.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **15th edition of the IPL in 2022** was won by the **Gujarat Titans**, led by captain Hardik Pandya.
 
• They **defeated the Rajasthan Royals** in the final by **7 wickets**.
 
• This was the Gujarat Titans' maiden IPL season.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Indian Premier League (IPL)**:

 
 
• It is a **men's Twenty20 (T20) cricket league** considered one of the most popular and exciting cricket tournaments annually held in India.
 
• It was established **by **the **BCCI (Board of Control for Cricket in India)** in **2007**.
 
• As of the 2024 season, the league has **ten teams** based in cities across India.
 
• The IPL's **headquarters **are situated inside the Cricket Centre next to the Wankhede Stadium in** Churchgate, Mumbai**.
 
• In the **16th edition** of the IPL in 2023, **Chennai Super Kings defeated Gujarat Titans**, by five wickets (DLS method) to win their fifth league title.
 
• The **2024 Indian Premier League** will be the **17th season**.
